description: Busan (부산) — Legacy 6-digit South Korean postal codes (구 우편번호) at submunicipal (동/리) level, with native Korean addresses and geographic coordinates. Source: Korea Data Hub National Postcode (2012-05); coordinates via Daum Local API. These 6-digit codes were superseded by the current 5-digit system in August 2015 and are retained here as a historical reference dataset.
